description.value:
Cost 3 Encore

Saving Throw Will

Traits Signal, auditory, emotion, incapacitation, linguistic, mental

You spend 3 Encore. Every enemy in range must attempt a Will save against your class DC. On a failure, the first action the creature takes on its next turn must be a Strike against a creature it considers an ally, chosen by the creature itself; if it cannot reach any ally, it wastes the action instead. On a success, nothing happens. A creature that cannot be compelled, or that has no allies within reach or range, is unaffected.

cinderfall.incomplete: SB1 (cost), and separately: forcing a specific future action choice onto a creature is a compulsion effect handled by GM/manual chat-card adjudication in real pf2e (comparable compulsion spells — e.g. Confusion/Command-style "attack" clauses — carry no rule element for the compulsion itself, consistent with P3's spell-convention statistic, though this specific card is a feat, not a spell, so this line is a reasoned extension of that convention rather than a directly cited example).
